ZERO new params (FoE nf24/k7/nb31=1920p + 1 alpha = 1921p, iter-7 byte-for-byte), peak lr UNCHANGED 5e-3, plain Adam (weight_decay 0.0; iter-14 proved wd does NOT help). The low-LR cosine tail OVERFITS the 200-slice train set (train MSE falls, val MSE rises); iter-7 only escaped by being budget-cut BEFORE the tail (accidental early-stop). iter-15 removes the tail ENTIRELY: with cosine off the trainer holds constant 5e-3 for the whole budget (epochs=16, hard max_train_s=1080 budget-cuts at ~ep8 exactly as iter-7). DEAD ENDS not repeated (all diverge to the 1.9e-4 attractor or freeze): capacity-up (iter-8 nf40 psnr1.87), depth-up (iter-9 K=7), momentum+per-step-alpha (iter-3), learned-init (iter-10/11 froze), higher peak LR (iter-12 1e-2 diverged ep3). Peak LR 5e-3 is the STABILITY EDGE - NOT exceeded. STABILITY: constant 5e-3 is everywhere <= iter-7 early-epoch LR (its cosine STARTS at the 5e-3 peak), iter-7 ran 5e-3 MONOTONE with no oscillation, grad_clip=1.0 caps spikes. SAFE FALLBACK if it oscillates near convergence: shallow anneal to eta_min=3e-3 (NOT 1e-5). HYPOTHESIS: holding the stable high LR with NO overfitting tail generalises BETTER than iter-7 partial anneal (which still dipped to 2.5e-3) -> val_rmse below 7.40e-4 -> hr ABOVE 0.2515, trend-endpoint champion at SAME 1921p/SAME 5e-3/SAME ~1331s wall. PREDICTED hr ~0.255-0.27.
